children: Overview
US life and health insurer's Q3 operating EPS rose 47% year-over-year
Company raised full-year operating EPS guidance, midpoint up 9% from prior
CNO repurchased $60 mln in shares and closed $270 mln reinsurance transaction
Outlook
CNO raises 2026 operating EPS guidance, midpoint up 9% from prior guidance
Result Drivers
ACTUARIAL REVIEW - Co said significant items from its annual actuarial review had a $44.9 mln net favorable impact on net income and net operating income
NEW PREMIUMS - Co said total new annualized premiums increased for the 17th consecutive qtr
AGENT COUNT GROWTH - Co said Consumer and Worksite segments delivered their 15th and 17th consecutive qtrs of producing agent count growth
